title: Dual-layer orthogonal acousto-optic sensor for alias-suppressed high-precision DOA sensing
authors: Xin Li; Cuicui Zhang; Zhenfei Gao; Zhicheng Li; Xiaobo Li; Bin Xue
matched_query: acousto-optic underwater acoustic sensing direction-of-arrival optical detection acoustic imaging
reasons: non-contact optical detection of underwater acoustic fields
metadata cross-verified from PubMed and OpenAlex/Optica DOI records
summary_en: A dual-layer orthogonal acousto-optic sensor uses six parallel laser beams to form a non-contact orthogonal dual-baseline geometry for underwater acoustic DOA estimation. Experiments demonstrate alias-suppressed sensing from 20 to 80 kHz and high-precision tracking at 75 kHz, making it directly relevant to acousto-optic acoustic-field sensing and imaging.
